signal.mechanism: A positive and year-on-year strengthening published quarterly current account may indicate persistent net external-flow support for RUB. This is a lagged regime hypothesis, not news surprise or measured MOEX conversion flow.
signal.primary: SI short0.9 only if latest published standalone-quarter current account is positive and strictly greater than same quarter of previous year as printed in the SAME publication; otherwise cash.
signal.control: Constant SI short0.9 on identical readiness/fill calendar; diagnostic, never promoted after outcomes.
signal.missing: Missing quarterly publication is not fabricated. Latest state expires120calendar days after publication. Missing or ambiguous table values, units, years or timing stop source assembly; do not substitute headline rounding or annual/cumulative values.
